FASLAPSETUP/| and friends should generate SYM properties for all symbols
which live in LSYMS - the globalsym patch is considerably faster than 
the search thru LAPFIV etc.  Also, FASLAP then wouldn't complain about
... undefined converted to DDT symbols ... when the loading Lisp won't
have to consult DDT.

Perhaps this means removing the distinction between globalsyms and extrasyms.
